summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Micromem Technologies Inc., a foreign private issuer, disclosing in an exhibit a press release about engaging two engineering students from the University of Toronto to advance a wearable gas sensor project under a collaborative research agreement with the Department of National Defence. The filing contains no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any corporate transaction. It is an ordinary operational update with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. There is no event triggering a special-situation classification; the filing is a standard current report of business progress.
